title: College of Computing, Data Science, and Society requirements

requirements.title: Reading & Composition A
requirements.notes: First half of R&C (an R1A or R4A course), or an AP/IB exam score. Complete by the end of your first year.

requirements.title: Reading & Composition B
requirements.notes: Second half of R&C (an R1B or R4B course). Complete by the end of your second year.

requirements.title: Computational Reasoning
requirements.notes: CDSS essential skill. Stub list of courses; most majors satisfy it with COMPSCI 61A, DATA C88C, or DATA C8.

requirements.title: Statistical Reasoning
requirements.notes: CDSS essential skill. Stub list; DATA C8 or STAT 20 is typical. In this planner a course counts toward only one CDSS essential skill.

requirements.title: Human & Social Dynamics of Data and Technology
requirements.notes: CDSS essential skill (Fall 2024+ admits). Stub list of approved courses; check the CDSS site for the official list.

requirements.title: Breadth: Arts & Literature
requirements.notes: One course from the approved list for this area. A course counts toward only one breadth area.

requirements.title: Breadth: Biological Science
requirements.notes: One course from the approved list for this area. A course counts toward only one breadth area.

requirements.title: Breadth: Historical Studies
requirements.notes: One course from the approved list for this area. A course counts toward only one breadth area.

requirements.title: Breadth: International Studies
requirements.notes: One International Studies course. In CDSS a second-semester (or higher) foreign language course also satisfies this area.

requirements.title: Breadth: Philosophy & Values
requirements.notes: One course from the approved list for this area. A course counts toward only one breadth area.

requirements.title: Breadth: Physical Science
requirements.notes: One course from the approved list for this area. A course counts toward only one breadth area.

requirements.title: Breadth: Social & Behavioral Sciences
requirements.notes: One course from the approved list for this area. A course counts toward only one breadth area.

requirements.title: 36 upper-division units
requirements.notes: Courses numbered 100-199. Up to 6 units of 300-level courses may count in some colleges.

requirements.title: Senior residence

rule.text: Senior residence: after reaching 90 units, complete at least 24 of your remaining units over two semesters in residence in your college

requirements.notes: Exceptions for UCEAP, UCDC, and other approved programs.
